description: I cannot log in to my account, it says invalid password
expected_resolution: Try resetting your password via the 'Forgot Password' link. If that doesn't work, clear your browser cache and cookies, then try again.

description: My bill shows a charge of $49.99 but I subscribed to the $29.99 plan
expected_resolution: Please check your invoice history in the billing portal. If the amount is incorrect, I can initiate a refund for the difference.

description: My website is down, I get a 503 error
expected_resolution: Check our status page for any ongoing incidents. If none, try restarting your server from the control panel and check the error logs.

description: How do I add a new email account to my domain?
expected_resolution: You can create a new email account via the cPanel Email Accounts section. I can provide step-by-step instructions.

description: I was charged twice this month for the same plan
expected_resolution: I apologize for the duplicate charge. I will verify the transactions and process a refund for the extra payment within 3-5 business days.

description: My admin panel is very slow, pages take 30 seconds to load
expected_resolution: Check your server resource usage (CPU, memory, disk I/O). High usage may indicate a need to upgrade or optimize your application.

description: I forgot my password and the reset email is not arriving
expected_resolution: Check your spam/junk folder for the reset email. Add no-reply@ourdomain.com to your safe senders list and request the reset again.

description: My SSL certificate expired and now my site shows 'Not Secure'
expected_resolution: Auto-renewal can be enabled in the SSL/TLS section of your control panel. I can also manually reissue the certificate for you.

description: I want to upgrade my hosting plan from Basic to Pro
expected_resolution: You can upgrade via the billing portal. The upgrade is prorated and your service will not experience downtime during the process.

description: My database connection keeps timing out after 30 seconds
expected_resolution: Check your database max_connections setting and connection pooling. Long-running queries may also cause timeouts.

description: I can't send emails from my domain, they bounce back
expected_resolution: Verify your DNS records (MX, SPF, DKIM). Emails may bounce due to missing or incorrect DNS configuration for your domain.

description: How do I point my domain to my new hosting account?
expected_resolution: Update your domain's nameservers to the ones provided in your welcome email. DNS propagation can take 24-48 hours.

description: I accidentally deleted an important file from my website
expected_resolution: Check the backups section in your control panel. We keep daily backups for 7 days. You can restore individual files from there.

description: My website was hacked and defaced
expected_resolution: This is critical. I will escalate to our security team immediately. In the meantime, change all passwords and restore from a backup before the incident.

description: I want to cancel my account
expected_resolution: You can cancel via the billing portal. Please export your data before cancellation as accounts are terminated after 30 days.

description: My PHP version is outdated and my application requires PHP 8.1
expected_resolution: You can change the PHP version in the control panel under Software > Select PHP Version. Test your application after the change.

description: The invoice PDF is not downloadable from the billing portal
expected_resolution: Try a different browser. If the issue persists, I can email the invoice PDF to you directly.

description: My cron jobs are not running as scheduled
expected_resolution: Verify the cron job syntax in the crontab. Check the cron logs for any error messages that indicate why it failed.

description: How do I enable HTTPS for my WordPress site?
expected_resolution: Install a free SSL certificate via Let's Encrypt in the control panel, then update your WordPress site URL to use HTTPS.

description: My subdomain is not resolving, I set it up 2 hours ago
expected_resolution: DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate. Verify the A record is correctly pointing to your server IP.

description: I need to transfer my domain to another registrar
expected_resolution: Unlock the domain in your control panel and request the EPP/authorization code. Provide this code to your new registrar.

description: My WordPress admin login is showing a white screen
expected_resolution: Disable all plugins via FTP by renaming the plugins folder. If it works, re-enable them one by one to find the culprit.

description: I want to add a second domain to my hosting account
expected_resolution: You can add an addon domain via the cPanel Domains section. The new domain will share your hosting resources.

description: My email is being marked as spam by recipients
expected_resolution: Set up SPF and DKIM DNS records for your domain. These authentication methods help improve email deliverability.

description: The disk space usage shows 100% but I don't have that many files
expected_resolution: Check for large log files, cache directories, and email mailboxes. System logs can accumulate and consume significant disk space.
